why.terrace: La Monumental (official, 1999) and Disturbio barras; loud, known across Mexico

why.voice: No supporter ownership or documented fan influence
why.conscience: Barra sanctioned in 2023 for travelling to away matches against the visiting-group ban; no racism sanction found; little visible inclusion work

why.contender: 16 league titles, incl. 2013, 2014, 2018, three in a row 2023-24; CONCACAF 2015, 2016; Femenil champions 2026
why.rituals: 'Ódiame más' unofficial motto; Súper Clásico v Chivas and Clásico Joven known well beyond Mexico

why.women: Club América Femenil: three titles (2018, 2023, 2026) and record crowds of 50,000+ at the Azteca
why.intensity: Possession-based attacking side under André Jardine (estimate)
